what: one netsim simulation (1040 weekly steps, 1500 nodes, two network layers) with no intervention, on one core, inside one R session. The rerun is the mean of 1 run(s) in one netsim call, as one run cannot be taken alone without a further long run (by scenario: none 45.1 s); the first run is that plus estimating the two networks (netest, 0.8 s). Neither includes starting R or loading EpiModel
